note: The GSTIN checker, as one file two engines answer to (#187). Python reads it from tests/test_sell_gstin.py, TypeScript from src/till/gstin.vectors.test.ts, and neither may be 'fixed' by editing this file - a vector changes only when the rule changes, and then it changes for both at once. The three registrations marked real exist; they are the whole argument that the mod-36 check digit is computed the way the GSTN computes it, because a checksum subtly wrong would pass its own unit tests happily and flag every genuine B2B bill KDPS ever takes.
